name: branding-violet-gradient-app-logo-on-phone-in-hand
title: White mirrored-smile logo on a violet-to-sand gradient phone screen held in a hand
whatItIs: A violet-to-indigo backdrop with faint giant shapes and a hand holding a phone whose screen fades from violet to sand with a white symbol of two connected rounded shapes forming a smile.
whatItMeans: Friendly and modern; the gradient screen makes a splash logo feel warm.
techniques: Show the logo on a gradient splash screen.
Match the backdrop to the screen colour.
Hold the phone upright in a hand.
Use giant faint logo shapes behind.

vocabulary.definition: The first screen with only a logo.
A colour blend across the phone screen.
A device held by a hand.
